lastChange.note: T4 (issue #171) review fixes: (1) bundle.css .os-popover-sep now stretches full width (align-self: stretch; margin: space-2 0), overriding the UA hr margin-inline: auto that shrank the separator before the link row to 0 width in the live menu and the static preview; PopoverMenu README anatomy names the rule. (2) Tooltip's Esc listener still hides a tooltip showing on another trigger but no longer stops an Esc pressed inside an open PopoverMenu, so one press closes the menu; Tooltip and PopoverMenu READMEs updated. (3) PopoverMenu Tab follows the WAI-ARIA menu pattern: Tab closes and moves focus to the next tabbable element after the trigger (scoped to the open dialog holding it; none: the trigger), Shift+Tab closes and returns focus to the trigger; README, index.d.ts and preview text updated. (4) PopoverMenu preview notice is a plain p, no role=status live region.
